analysis.scope: Offline raw-result/ledger/current-frame equality and descriptive reaggregation; independent trace/visual audit recorded separately

initialState: primary blocked; not autonomous discovery of a dead end
limitations: All trials start on an explicitly blocked primary screen; initial exposure does not establish self-directed discovery of a dead end.
Snapshot ground truth, successful current-frame delivery, model self-reports and actual UI operations are separate evidence. Delivered pixels do not establish reading or understanding.
Behavior counts describe locally established transitions in attempted trials, including partial/faulted trials. Valid objective outcomes and valid-run means have their own denominators.
Prerequisite roles require actual successful clicks with one matching confirm/reconcile counter increment; certification routes are never consulted.
Revisits require a recorded UI departure and return. Wait, reread and repeated observations do not establish a revisit. Missing transitions are not interpolated.
Terminal snapshots may establish actual state after the last UI operation but never establish model exposure or an unrecorded URL.
An unchanged-eligibility early return records lack of prerequisite progress; it is not a prohibition or a claim about natural human behavior.
Absence of an observed or delivered opportunity is not evidence of successful avoidance, comprehension or correct release decisions.
Two repeats per task/condition provide descriptive evidence only; no human fidelity, broad stability or causal claim.
Limits and infrastructure failures remain separate. A final saved UI state may satisfy the objective without a later delivered confirmation or subjective done.

independentAudit.scope: Implementation and evidence; model stability unmet, human fidelity unverified.
